_meta.what: Apex Gardens (DEMO) keyword rule table for the Jev bake-off. Mirrors the SHAPE of a real client table (escalate_only safety class + fast_lane commercial cards) with invented estate data only. Same fields lib/keywords.js compiles.
_meta.jev_description: One line per rule, written for the Jev Choice question. It describes what the BUYER is asking, never the answer we give.

rules.jev_description: Asks about investment returns, rental yield, ROI, appreciation or what the unit will be worth in future
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Great question for a person, not a chat window. Shall I have the sales team call you today?

rules.jev_description: Wants a refund, to cancel, withdraw or back out of a purchase already made
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] I'll get a senior member of the team on this for you now. What's the best number to reach you on?

rules.jev_description: Asks for bank or account details, or says they are ready to pay or transfer money now
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Wonderful. For your safety, payment details only ever come from the sales team directly. Can they call you in the next hour?

rules.jev_description: Asks for a discount, a lower price, the last price, or tries to negotiate
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Let me put you straight through to the sales lead on that. When's a good time for a quick call?

rules.jev_description: Asks whether the estate is genuine, a scam, under litigation, in court, or troubled by omonile or land grabbers
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Completely fair to ask. Our team will walk you through every document in person. Shall I set that up?

rules.jev_description: Asks about a mortgage, bank loan, NHF, pension-backed or any third-party financing
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Our sales lead handles financing questions personally. What's the best number to reach you on?

rules.jev_description: Asks about the 2-bedroom condo or apartment (price, size, features)
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] The 2-bedroom condo is 110 sqm at ₦95m, with 4 left. Would you like to inspect it this Saturday?

rules.jev_description: Asks about the 3-bedroom terrace (price, size, features)
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] The 3-bedroom terrace is 185 sqm at ₦160m, with boys quarters and two parking spaces. Shall I book you a viewing?

rules.jev_description: Asks about the 4-bedroom semi-detached house (price, size, features)
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] The 4-bedroom semi-detached is 260 sqm at ₦240m, with a rooftop terrace. Would a Tuesday or Saturday viewing suit you?

rules.jev_description: Asks about the 5-bedroom detached house (price, size, features)
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] The 5-bedroom detached is 340 sqm at ₦380m, and there is one left. Shall I hold a viewing slot for you?

rules.jev_description: Asks the price or cost without naming a specific unit type
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Prices run from ₦95m (2-bed condo) to ₦380m (5-bed detached). Which size are you considering?

rules.jev_description: Asks whether units are still available or how many are left
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Yes: 4 condos, 2 terraces, 3 semi-detached and 1 detached left. Which one should I tell you about?

rules.jev_description: Asks where the estate is, the address or directions
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] We're at 1 Apex Gardens Drive, Lekki Phase 1. Would you like to come and see it?

rules.jev_description: Wants to inspect, visit, view or book a site tour in person
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Inspections run Tuesdays and Saturdays, 10am to 4pm. Which day works for you?

rules.jev_description: Is abroad or in the diaspora, or wants a video call or virtual tour instead of visiting
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Live video inspections run Tuesdays 7pm and Saturdays 4pm WAT. Shall I book you in?

rules.jev_description: Asks about payment plans, instalments, spreading payment or the initial deposit
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Three options: outright with 5% off, 12 months (30% down) or 18 months (35% down). Which suits you best?

rules.jev_description: Asks about the title, C of O, Governor's Consent, survey or other land documents
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Title is Governor's Consent, and every document is available for your lawyer to review. Shall I arrange that?

rules.jev_description: Asks about amenities, power, security, water, roads, gym or the service charge
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Underground power, a water treatment plant, CCTV and 24-hour security. Service charge from ₦1.2m a year. Would you like the full list?

rules.jev_description: Asks when the estate will be completed, finished or handed over
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Phase 1 handover is scheduled for Q2 2027, with monthly construction updates. Shall I add you to them?

rules.jev_description: Expresses general interest or asks for more information without a specific question
rules.dm_response: [DEMO] Apex Gardens has 2- to 5-bedroom homes in Lekki Phase 1 from ₦95m. What size are you looking for?
